source.method: static scan of parsed source literals `info.HealInfo{}` and `info.DrainInfo{}`; no build or tests

sharedCoreBoundary.heal: internal/template/character/heal.go + packages/source-host/patches/021-character-healing.patch: source type/base, HealBonus, amount, dynamic ReceiveHeal delegation, and overheal stages have runtime records. This records Src as a supplied input; caller arithmetic is not reconstructed unless separately attached.
sharedCoreBoundary.drain: internal/template/character/heal.go + packages/source-host/patches/006-player-shield-health.patch: supplied DrainInfo.Amount is used in HP mutation; PlayerDrain records hpBefore/maxHP/Amount and resulting ratio under a runtime ledger request ID (ID is discarded by the Go caller). Caller Amount derivation is not reconstructed.
sharedCoreBoundary.identifiers: runtime receipt IDs are per execution/request; these are not compile-time source formula IDs. Message/Abil is descriptive identity only.

batchPlan.work: First broad implementation batch: lift native source amount arithmetic into per-call formula receipt using talent level and live stat provenance; avoid touching shared base/bonus/receive/overheal phases.
Attach source expression/level/constants at native HealInfo or DrainInfo creation; percent HealType still delegates target MaxHP multiplication to shared core.
Capture stat provenance at the native source read; preserve whether current MaxHP/ATK/EM is sampled at creation or application.
Carry original Snapshot or helper-calculation links instead of rereading current stats; expand helper math only when explicit reusable formula needed.
Attach stored field and event lineage (e.g. threshold drains, stack-scaled heal, delayed tick); retain event gating and application order in Go.
Keep zero-amount event emissions separate from numeric drain formula migration; they can trigger OnPlayerHPDrain consumers even when no numeric amount is authored here.

limitations: Only Go HealInfo/DrainInfo struct literal sites are enumerated; API calls forwarding existing HealInfo values are represented by the literal that creates that value where found, not duplicated as new amount sources.
Nearest local definitions are a bounded textual aid, not full Go dataflow; opaque locals/helpers remain explicitly classified instead of inferred.
This is source provenance inventory, not game-mechanics verification.

The automated literal census found 96 Go literals (82 HealInfo and 14 DrainInfo); local-definition discovery is nearest textual assignment only, so deeper helper/state dependencies must be inspected before implementing a source formula.

entryFamilies.meaning: source expression is evaluated by Go at HealInfo construction; shared receipt treats the resulting Src as a supplied input.
retain original snapshot read and frame; do not replace with current source stats.
Src is ratio; shared base stage performs target MaxHP multiplication. The ratio/refinement source can still be opaque at caller.
some local definitions resolved in nearbyDefinition; otherwise helper output remains opaque; preserve sequence and captured snapshots.
the Drain receipt records final Amount; source expression and threshold/state source remain Go-only.
Dehya amount depends on special player-hit/shield pipeline; Sara zero amount is an event trigger, not authored numeric damage.
